# MessageCenter

**Class:** `UltraCanvasMessageCenter` · **Group:** [Navigation and data views](../Groups/Navigation-and-data-views.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/UltraMessage/UltraCanvasMessageCenter.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/UltraMessage/UltraCanvasMessageCenter.h) · `#include "Plugins/UltraMessage/UltraCanvasMessageCenter.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

The desktop message centre: every chat, mail and notification on the UltraMessage feed, with sources, filters, search and the notification's actions ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasMessageCenter.md))

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasMessageCenter](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasMessageCenter.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMessageCenter> CreateMessageCenter( const std::string& identifier, float x = 0, float y = 0, float w = 0, float h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasMessageCenter(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onOpen` | `std::function<void(const MessageCenterEntry&)> onOpen` | _Open_ |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(const MessageCenterEntry*)> onSelectionChanged` | nullptr = nothing selected |
| `onUnreadCountChanged` | `std::function<void(int unread)> onUnreadCountChanged` | _Unread count changed_ |
| `onError` | `std::function<void(const UltraMsgResult&)> onError` | _Error_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

| `DefaultConnectOptions` | `static UltraMsgConnectOptions DefaultConnectOptions()` | App id "org.ultraos.messagecenter", display name "Message Centre", UI-thread delivery, hosting a broker when none answers. |
| `Connect` | `bool Connect(const UltraMsgConnectOptions& options = DefaultConnectOptions())` | Connects, loads the history and subscribes.
